completion.summary: CI was red for four commits. Windows: the output test asked for the rich layout but not for a Unicode terminal, so the legacy-console fallback gave `...` and `ok`; the test env now sets WT_SESSION. Playwright job: apt could not resolve its host twice; the install step tries once more after 30 s. Local CLI test timeout 5 s to 15 s: the suite timed out in four runs while other work loaded the machine.

title: CI red on Windows: output test expects Unicode symbols the legacy console detection replaces; Playwright install fails
